newsitem.title: USA: S&P adds Tracor, Innovex, others.
newsitem.headline: S&P adds Tracor, Innovex, others.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said Tuesday it is adding Pioneer Natural Resources Co, Innovex Inc, Tracor Inc and Central Parking Corp to its indexes over the next few days.

Pioneer Natural is to be formed by the merger of Parker & Parsley Petroleum and MESA Inc, and it will be added to the S&P MidCap 400 Index on August 8. MESA will be replaced in the SmallCap 600 Index by Innovex Inc.
S&P said Tracor will replace RDM Sports Group Inc in the S&P SmallCap 600 Index because RDM's stock has consistently traded below $1 per share.
After August 11, Central Parking will replace Control Data Systems Inc in the S&P SmallCap 600. Control Data is being acquired by the investment firm of Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe.
Pioneer Natural Resources of Irving, Texas, is to be one of the nation's largest independent oil and gas exploration and production companies and will be added to the S&P MidCap 400 Oil & Gas group.
Innovex, headquartered in Hopkins, Minnesota, makes lead wire assemblies used in computer disk drives and in medical devices and will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 Computers group.

Tracor makes and provides defense electronics products, systems and services used by U.S. military and government agencies. The Austin, Texas, company, will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 Electronics group.
Central Parking is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. It owns and operates parking facilities across the globe and will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 Services group.
